description.value:
Prerequisites: —

The engineer builds a powerful device that allows him to reach out and manipulate metallic objects. This device can either be held or worn on a hand taking up a ring magic item slot. As a standard action he can activate it to create an effect identical to the Grab (black mage cantrip) using the engineer's level as the caster level with the exception that it can only affect primarily metallic objects. The engineer can use this gadget only after it has been charged. Charging the gadget requires a full hour of operating the hand crank on the gadget for five minutes of use.
